steps.title: model: apps, ir_web logins, host (storage, identity, CLI admin)
steps.scope:
prep.md §2.0, §2.1 (DB/config parts), §3 items 1-6, decisions 1-6. No Bot concept.
- Schema migration(s) after the current last one: terminals become apps (ID and token_hash kept; the old kind becomes a display-only type; Terminal.Bot/Chatless flags go away (follows stay until S4a)); panels become logins of the built-in app ir_web (IDs kept); the old `logins` table (panel cookie sessions) renamed `web_sessions`; new `logins` table (app, id, name, avatar, approved_at NULL=pending, last_active, perms placeholder); invites become pre-approved login slots carrying perms; devices move to logins; `local` stays the host's storage ID, displayed 主机/host. Also a one-time cleanup of push_subscriptions rows whose owner is not `local` and not an ir_web login (P1 review leftover; add a test).
- Write a synthetic DB fixture generator at the pre-migration schema (all tables later steps migrate or drop) and a migration test proving data carries over (tokens still authenticate, panels can still log in, usage kept).
- gate: Identity gets App + Login; until S2 changes permissions, keep today's behaviour by mapping ir_web logins / host to the old panel/local paths and other apps to the old channel path (record shims in progress.md for S2).
- api types: Terminal → App and Login (+ types.gen.ts); name rules: unique per scope, length limit, no '/', reserved host/主机/本机/ir_web, single ASCII letter banned; validation tests.
- CLI: `ir terminals …` admin commands become `ir apps …` (list, rename, rm, logins); remove `ir token`, POST /api/terminals/tokens, --owner, --into. Drop config `pairClosed` (legacy-tolerated already).
- Minimal web compile fixes for renamed types only (UI rework is S1c).

steps.title: pairing window, update pairing, needs queue (backend), catalogue
steps.scope:
draft 二「接入」, prep §2.1, decisions 6-12, 15.
- One POST /api/pair + GET /api/pair/{request}; delete /api/exec/pair and bot-pair. Closed by default → 403 pair_closed; opened for 10 minutes via `ir apps open [dur]` / `ir apps close` (host only) and a web API; limits 4 pending per source (IP; IPv6 by /64; reuse the existing real-IP logic) and 20 total. `ir pair` and `ir join` retry while pair_closed. ir join's default name = hostname.
- Requests carry wanted permissions (agents, scope; plain data now, S2 enforces); approval may only reduce. Duplicate name: no auto-suffix; approver chooses update pairing (same app, new token, old token void, usage/perms kept, warn when old app online) or deny, or renames on approval.
- needs queue replacing confirms: kinds app_join, app_update, app_change, login_join, plus the existing invite/secret-set/secret-use confirms; GET /api/needs, POST /api/needs/{id}; `ir needs`, `ir allow <id>`, `ir deny <id>`. Who may approve: host, and ir_web logins with full scope and all agents; agents' ir never (fix CanManage letting agents through).
- Login join: an unknown login of an app speaking for the first time → 403 login_pending + a login_join need; per app at most 20 pending; approved → login row approved_at set; removal: next message re-applies.
- 401 only for invalid/void tokens; every other refusal 403 with a reason code (JSON {code, message}).
- Delete /api/extensions, internal/server/extensions.go, update.Updater.Extension, web extensions.tsx; add a hard-coded catalogue (name, description, type, per-OS install commands incl. dsh plugin and iridium-qq) at GET /api/catalogue.
- Tests for window, limits, update pairing, needs, login join, codes.

steps.title: web: 应用管理, app detail, 新建应用, 需要 cards
steps.scope:
draft 四, prep §2.1 web, §2.6.
- 终端管理 → 应用管理 (route #/settings/terminals redirects): one list with host (not manageable), 网页 (ir_web) and other apps; each row avatar, name, type, online, last activity; apps with agents show agents and OS.
- 新建应用: opens the pairing window (10 min countdown, close early) + catalogue install commands (copyable, per OS) + `ir pair` hint.
- App detail: permissions section (agents, scope: editable fields wired to the S1b data; S2 enforces), carried agents toggles (if data exists yet, else placeholder hidden), shell switch read-only, logins list (rename, perms, remove, last active), rename/avatar, delete.
- 需要: questions/approvals/plans as today plus app join (code, OS, program, agents, wanted permissions that can be struck out, update pairing choice), app change (what more/less), login join; host/admin-only actions.
- Remove extensions UI, invites as login slots in 网页's logins. i18n zh/en keys consistent; web tests updated.

steps.title: permissions: agents, folder scope, login ⊆ app, every route checked
steps.scope:
draft 二「权限」, prep §2.3, §3 items 14-19, decisions 14-19. Fold in P2: a route registry where every route declares an access category (test fails on an undeclared route), and a permission-matrix test (identities: host, ir_web login full, ir_web login narrowed, app with/without an agent, narrowed login of an app, agent in a host session via socket, executor session token) — expected codes per category.
- Perms{Agents (list or all), Scope (places or all)} on apps and logins replace claudeOwner/带 Claude (migrate: Claude-owner → agents all, else all but claude; scope all). Effective = login ∩ app at check time. Granting Claude: host or a login that can use Claude; record by/at.
- Every endpoint checks agent + scope of the session or place it touches, incl. archive/rename (PATCH sessions), messages/presets/rules/image/files/uploads/folders/dsh routes that are unchecked today; sessions of a disallowed agent are read-only; out-of-scope sessions/places invisible (lists, hub state via Sub.Filter per login, discover, usage).
- Shared layout (colors, group order (merge, not whole-table replace), placement, pins) editable within scope; folder_colors keys in place form; root-less notes only for full scope.
- Turn origin: persist the originating login per turn (inputs.login, usage.login, openers.login) following the dispatch chain to the first human login; no human → host. Session token (irs_) and host-session agents' ir act with app perms ∩ originating login.
- Credentials: list/set/delete host + admin-capable logins; use only via host socket.
- Web: app detail and login perms editing (agents checkboxes; Claude terms notice; scope editor by place), sidebar/lists show only in-scope.
- Remove S1 shims mapping logins to panel/channel paths.

steps.title: carried agents, places, machines merged into apps, ir sh via run
steps.scope:
draft 二「带 Agent」「远端执行命令」+ 位置, prep §2.2, decisions 20-24. Fold in P4: Hub.Find stale-name bug, phantom machines, dropGone guard.
- Exec hello reports the machine (os, home, agents, shell owner switch default off, machine-id hash); wire.Protocol not bumped, fields additive; old noShell/agentShell map to shell = agentShell && !noShell. `ir join --shell` (old flags still accepted). Per-app agent enable toggles (API + app detail UI); a disabled agent can't be started there. Host apps: machine-id hash equal to the host's → its agents stripped, connection kept; env override for tests.
- Machines merged into apps: delete GET /api/machines and the separate machine concept (web machines.tsx folded into apps/sidebar); `ir new <agent> <place> "task"` with place prefixes replaces --machine.
- Places: internal/place (Go) and a web places module sharing one fixture table: `应用名:路径`, host:/主机: reserved, split on first colon, prefix looked up by name, inputs without prefix = caller's own machine, outputs always prefixed. Storage keeps ID:path. Remove the `机器/<id>` session syntax.
- `ir sh` via the exec protocol's `run` ({line,cwd,env?} → run.out / run.exit events, run.stop, kill on disconnect), server streams NDJSON like /api/cli, no polling; cap negotiation: executor without `run` falls back to the hold way. Implement run in internal/remote/executor (Go) and scripts/dev/exec-mini.py (note: the main tree has uncommitted WIP in exec-mini.py; edit next's copy anyway and note it); dsh plugin unchanged (falls back). GET /api/shell/{run} remains only for the host web $.
- exec-mini.py: only 401 means a void token (403 with reason codes must not delete the token).

steps.title: events per login, needs for asks, send/share, delete the chat layer
steps.scope:
draft 二「推送」「消息」「要删的」, prep §2.4, decisions 25-32 (non-Satori parts).
- Event production: every hosted session's events go to links whose login can see the session (S2), carrying the turn's originating login; heavy streams (draft, session state, context) only to links that said they are watching (web keeps hub SSE ?sub=session: as watching). Store durable events (message-created/updated equivalents, buttons, channel changes) in the outbox keyed by seq for 24h (Satori lane B will expose them as sn).
- needs covers questions, approvals, plans (sent to logins that can use the session, with originating login) in addition to S1b's applications; answering via POST /api/sessions/{id}/answer accepting CardAnswer (POST /api/answer deleted).
- `ir send <target> "msg"`: target a session (sends) or `app/login` (display only, no agent woken); delivery checks (online, login can use the sending session) else a clear error. `ir bot` deleted. Public list of apps and logins (GET /api/apps public part).
- share: POST share of a session / a reply / a place / a file to a login, with sharer and note; checked that the target can use it; web 分享到 ▸ menus (session, reply, file, place) replace 拉进会话/切到此会话.
- GET /api/sessions/{id}/commands (agent's own commands).
- Delete: internal/chat (move reply rendering to internal/files, keep onNotice turn-text logic where events need it), routes_plugin.go, /api/chat/*, /api/bot, POST /api/sessions/{id}/bot, follows (table, routes, UI), chat_pointers, chat_seen, bot_follows (with the delete statement in store/terminals.go), Session.Bots, `@` stays reference-only. The two profile paths merge into one.
- Web Push → /api/web/push/*, ir_web logins and host only, delivered per login.
- qqbridge: keep compiling (it becomes non-functional until rewritten; drop its tests that only exercised removed APIs, note it).

steps.title: Satori with ir (lane B, parallel)
steps.scope: draft 三, prep §2.5, decisions 1, 25-28, 30-31. Spec copy: ~/kumo/satori-spec-50fee9ef (satorijs/docs@50fee9ef) — follow it exactly where the draft doesn't deviate. This lane runs in parallel with S2/S3/S4a on another worktree: build internal/satori against the S1 model (apps, logins), forwarding to existing session logic through small interfaces (an EventSource and the handlers), so the merge can wire it to S4a's events and S2's checks. Note in progress.md every place the merge must connect. - HTTP: POST /v1/{resource}.{method} with Satori-Platform (= app ID) and Satori-User-ID (= login ID) choosing the login; message.create/get/list (BidiList paging), channel.get/list/update, guild.get/list, login.get, user.get, upload.create (single multipart + channel_id), the internal: resource proxy route, meta; 404 only for unknown routes, missing resources 422 with reason codes (no_such_session…), spec-mandated 400/403 kept. - WS /v1/events: op EVENT 0, PING 1, PONG 2, IDENTIFY 3 (token + sn resume), READY 4 (logins), META 5; heartbeat 10s; our extras (machine report, watching) as extra fields; transient stuff (drafts, state) as custom ops ≥6, not EVENT; sn = outbox seq, 24h. - Events: message-created/updated, interaction/button, channel-*, login-*; progress → message-created, answered asks → message-updated; status dropped. - Elements codec: text, for sessions, / for places and files (never ), / via internal: refs,
